itch.title: Skill notes: Ki Slash — choosing when to release
itch.bodyEN:
Today we are introducing an existing skill in EXODUSER: HELL LORD. Ki Slash sends out blade waves on its first two attacks. During the third attack, holding the left mouse button charges the blade; releasing fires it in the current aim direction.

The choice is between releasing early to continue attacking and charging longer for a stronger third strike. Which rhythm feels more appealing to you? We would also like to hear whether this input description is clear.

This entry explains a development feature. It does not announce a new public-demo patch, and development content may differ from the public demo. No new gameplay recording is included in this post. We will keep the feature note separate from a future normal-play demonstration.

The game uses AI-assisted art and audio.
Read the official skill note: https://www.youtube.com/post/Ugkxpb6uTCUIAd3Ypj4_1vsi9cv2BKT-F93l
Free Steam demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4749590
